name: Ayres Georg
source:
A member of the mafia group 'Evening Star'.
His true form is of a prison guard of Hell Alastor.
It's his job to deal with traitors, so he is feared by the other members of the mafia.
On the other hand outside of battle situations he's a bit unreliable.
For some reason he is attached to [url=/c43597]Beel[/url] and is always looking after him.
